We connect the brightest minds in Europe to make industry greener, smarter and truly sustainable.

Jobomschrijving

Primary responsibilities project management support (50%):

• Creating timelines and contributing to effective planning of funded project activities.
• Monitoring budgets of EU-funded projects and tracking team members’ time dedication consistently, systematically, and coherently.
• Supporting team members in completing tasks, drafting, and submitting reports.
• Oversee and implement the communication and dissemination tasks of projects.
• Support organising conferences, events, meetings, and other activities linked to projects.
• Providing communication support to Processes4Planet projects.
•  
• Communications activities and providing value to members (50%)
• Create a yearly Communication Plan and track its implementation,
• Manage and enhance the Association’s external communication channels (website, social media, newsletters, etc.), 
• Operate members-only collaboration tools (e.g. SharePoint),
• Manage internal communication with company members by operating the existing tools or suggesting new ideas.
• Generate and write content for social media, news releases, newsletters, bulletins, etc.
• Prepare presentations and small publications and manage relations with providers.
• Support to facilitate networking activities 
• Organise participation in external conferences, and support with organization of internal events (conferences, workshops, webinars, etc.).

Qualifications and experience:

Degree in project management, communications, public relations, business administration or related studies.

Minimum 3 years of experience in positions dealing with the tasks described for this position, with excellent performance.

Experience with EU funds is an asset.

Your key skills:

An energetic person with a hands-on approach, task-oriented with attention to detail

Team player with a cooperative spirit

Ability to work in a small core team and diverse virtual teams with people across organizational boundaries and several countries/regions.

Outstanding organisation and prioritization skills with a capacity to retro plan and fulfil strict deadlines.

High-quality results and output oriented.

Capacity to work with complexity and to juggle a variety of tasks flexibly and proactively.

Creative problem-solving skills, able to anticipate needs and deliver your work autonomously

Technical skills and languages:

Strong skills in Word, PowerPoint, Excel and collaborative online tools (e.g. SharePoint).

Experience in project management.

Excellent spoken and written English. Other languages are an asset.

The company 

Our client is an American pharmaceutical company with offices in 18 countries.

Jobomschrijving

Mission

You will be responsible for the administrative organization of meetings, the HCP/HCO contracting process, the transparency reports for events with healthcare professionals in respect of budget, local rules, and internal compliance rules.

Customer Focus

Key Objectives/Deliverables:

HCP Meetings And Contracts Management

HealthCare Organisation Sponsorship Management

Compliance

Business Planning And Operations

Requirements
 

Minimum education level: Bachelor’s degree.

Ability to communicate clearly and succinctly with all audiences and forums through exemplary English, Dutch and French oral and written communication skills.

Pharmaceutical industry experience, and/or customer service experience in meeting management.

Ability to travel up to 20% (between Belgium and the Netherlands);

Excellent time-management, and critical thinking skills with ability to work effectively in a team, cross-functional, matrix, and global multi-cultural and virtual environment.

Demonstrate strong customer focus with the ability to develop professional relationships in all aspects of the position that result in stable, consistent, reliable, and courteous communication when dealing with other key business partners and external customers.

Strong proficiency and learning agility with various computer applications and software.

Ability to solve problems and work independently in a changing and multi-tasking environment with numerous deadlines.
 

Additional info:

Contract of limited duration of 1 year

The company  is een familie bedrijf actief in de Security wereld in België en Nederland. 

Jobomschrijving

Your Mission

•    Coordinate maintenance contracts and ensure contractual commitments are fulfilled.
•    Plan and follow up preventive maintenance activities.
•    Coordinate service reviews, reporting activities and follow-up actions.
•    Monitor maintenance invoicing, renewals and contract amendments.
•    Maintain contract documentation, service procedures and operational records throughout the contract lifecycle.
•    Act as the operational reference for maintenance contracts and contract-related information across the company.
•    Support engineers and internal teams with contract-related questions.
•    Coordinate subcontractors and ensure service activities are properly tracked.
•    Support customer communication and manage operational escalations when required.
•    Identify risks, priorities and improvement opportunities before they impact service management.

During your journey at Tein Technology, you'll develop expertise in:
•    Service Delivery & Contract Management
•    Customer Relationship
•    Operational Planning & Coordination
•    Service Reporting & Business Performance Monitoring
•    Mission-Critical Voice, Video & Network Services

POSITION’S REQUIREMENTS 
Education, Knowledge & Experience
•    Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
•    Experience in service coordination, operations, administration or customer support.
•    Strong organisational and planning skills.
•    Interest in technology, customer service and operational excellence.
What Makes You a Great Fit
•    Fluent in Dutch and/or French, with a good command of English.
•    Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
•    Customer-oriented with excellent communication skills.
•    Proactive, action-driven and comfortable taking ownership.
•    Commercial mindset with the ability to identify opportunities and improvements.
•    Comfortable coordinating engineers, customers and external partners.
•    Structured and detail-oriented without losing sight of the bigger picture.
•    Calm and effective under pressure.
•    Curious about technology and service management.
•    Eager to grow towards a Service Delivery Management role.

European Association located in the heart of Brussels. 

Jobomschrijving

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Support the team to organise workshops and events,

Prepare meetings and events material,

Take care of communication actions, updating websites, registrations, newsletters, etc.

Support team members to fulfil the association's role in the EU-funded projects (timesheets, drafting and submitting reports, etc.).

Archiving documents, updating CRM, and other administration tasks.

Support the team in other ad-hoc assignments related to the day-to-day activities of the association. 

SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS 

Degree in communication, administration, project management or related studies. 

Experience in a similar position.

Should be able to work autonomously with little supervision.

Should be well organised, flexible and open-minded. 

Should be able to set priorities, follow strict deadlines, be proactive 

Should have good IT skills (Outlook, Office 365) and communication tools knowledge & understanding 

Knowledge and experience within the European context in Brussels would be highly considered. 

Very good writing and communication skills and a sense of diplomacy. 

Excellent spoken and written English.

Jobomschrijving

OBJECTIVES: 

Assist the Commercial department and assure all is properly coordinated between the different 
departments and reflected in the system. 
 
 
A.DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 
The commercial assistant will perform the following tasks and activities: 
 
1. Commercial tasks. 95 % 

? Introduce, review and validate the sales and purchase contracts in SAP based on the sales offers

2. Backup function for administration. 5 %

Internal

? Regular coordination with the logistic department with regard to delivery and stock issues that may 
affect the customers. 
? Regular coordination with the administration department in respect of documentary credits and follow-up 
of orders and shipments. 
 
External 
? Liaise with customers and agents. 
? Co-ordination of export sales with the sales and logistic departments in Madrid, San Roque and Bécancour. 

duction process

? Master degree or equivalent through experience.

? Knowledge of English, basic knowledge of Spanish and any other language is a     SAP system.

? Documentary credits.

? Some understanding of logistic operations.

European Association in het center of Brussels

Jobomschrijving

Become the backbone of a collaborative team and help drive seamless operations.

Secretariat in general, including
•    administrative support to General Secretary and other staff members
•    liaise with the office landlord, suppliers and contractors to keep the office welcoming and in good shape
•    support the events organisation, i.e. the practicalities (hotel, venue, catering, …) for the yearly “National Association Meetings, “International Harmonisation Council” and a “Summit rehearsal”

Suppliers
•    Scouting if needed
•    Organizing, ordering & reception of all office supplies, drinks, etc
•    Contact with suppliers: e-mail correspondence, telephone requests
•    Price quotations, ordering with approval of General Secretary
•    Filing of contracts
•    Ordering & follow-up of maintenance/repair of material, machines
•    In contact with the cleaning service and plants’ service

Building
•    Access badges 
•    Contact with representative of the building workers for the organization and timing of works (avoiding noise & disturbance for & visitors on our busy meeting days)
•    Responsible for evacuating  & visitors in every case of alarm and during building escape exercises.  Sending report to the building representative afterwards.
•    Organise maintenance of kitchen machines

Mail
•    Opening and distribution of mail
•    E-Mailing of invitations to Summits
 

•    Checking incoming mail, answering, forwarding
•    Clearing inbox of all possible junk, clear spam box

Insurances (except for insurances linked to staff)
•    Follow-up of insurances

•    Fluent in English (written and oral). (French, Dutch or other languages are appreciated)
•    Experience in a similar function
•    Knowledgeable in IT (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint)

Jobomschrijving

• Handle general accounting, invoice management, VAT, budget, forecasts, audits, and risk management
• Work closely with other companies at an international level
• Participate in hands-on accounting practices with internal training provided by team members

• Contribute to various accounting tasks related to agriculture and the agrifood sector

International Energy company is looking for Management Assistant English, French and Dutch.

Jobomschrijving

• Administration support : travels arrangements, expense claims, contacts, follow up holiday planning CCT members, Country Chair budget set up and monitoring, etc.
• Communication support..
• Meetings planning, logistics preparations, minutes sharing with staff.
• Support Social Investments plan and track execution.
• Events preparation support : staff party, Family Day,...
•  

You graduated recently or you already have a first work experience in a similar function.

You have excellent communication in English, French & Dutch (spoken/written).

An leading independent law firm based in Brussels and London is searching for an administrative assistant.

Jobomschrijving

As a trilingual Administrative Assistant, you are the seamless link between teams, clients and leaders — elevating communication, efficiency and collaboration across every

Document & Information Management

Create, format and refine documents and timesheets with accuracy and attention to detail.

Update and maintain the contact database to ensure flawless information flow.

Edit and manage office floorplans when needed.

Meetings & Events Coordination

Organize meetings and conference calls, ensuring smooth logistics from start to finish.

Provide support for both internal and external events, contributing to their seamless execution.

Reception Support

Act as backup for reception:

Second floor: during lunch breaks, holidays and receptionist absences.

First floor: during client meetings.

You’re a sharp, fast-moving administrative powerhouse who keeps everything — and everyone — on track. Fully fluent in English, French and Dutch, you switch between languages with ease, making communication smooth and effortless across the entire organization.

You love bringing order to chaos: calendars run better, documents look sharper, and operations flow smoother because you’re behind them. Detail-driven but always thinking two steps ahead, you anticipate needs before they appear and handle challenges with confidence and positivity.

People count on you because you deliver — with efficiency, professionalism and a smile.

You’re proactive, reliable and naturally service-minded, making you the go-to person for both colleagues and clients. In short: you’re the kind of assistant who makes the whole office work better.

Our client is an international organisation specialising in rail transport.

Jobomschrijving

Do you have a little experience in communications and you are looking for experience in an international environment? We're looking for you for a 5-month project (ASAP - Early October) !

Main mission 

The candidate will be responsible for assisting the Communication Officer in the creation and integration of content on their website.

Receive briefings and requests for content creation from the various stakeholders in the organisation

Plan the copy work and communicate clear deadlines to the stakeholders, taking into account potential back-and-forth and validation.

Create content in line with the Thalys tone of voice and internal processes, taking account of SEO constraints

Ensuring that the content is validated by the various stakeholders before being sent to the translators

Reviewing the content once it has been translated and integrating it into our CMS according to the production process

Profile 

Bilingual in French and English, both spoken and written

At least two years' experience in copywriting and content integration in drupal

Very good knowledge of the CMS

Good knowledge of digital marketing, copywriting and SEO

Personality: customer-oriented, creative, proactive, autonomous, good writing and communication skills, good organisational skills, team player

The company is a not-for-profit making organisation which represents large, medium and small companies across Europe.

Jobomschrijving

Mission of the role:

In this role, you will provide efficient support the Executive Director Innovation in the execution and achievement of his tasks primarily in area of agenda management and email communications.

The successful candidate will frequently interact with high level internal and external contacts and assistant the Executive Director in the daily management of the Innovation team.

Are you inspired by these responsibilities?

For the Executive Director, you will:

• Independently manage his agenda and efficiently co-ordinate the arrangement of meetings, travel, etc.
• Sort emails, answers questions within the framework of certain instructions; transfer more complex issues to the appropriate persons in absence of the Executive Director
• Organize and manage all logistical elements related to international/internal/external meetings, presentations, seminars, events, visits….
• Provide general administrative support within broad guidelines (e.g. making presentations, translating letters and documents).
• Manage the Extranet/Website.
• Perform basic accounting tasks of specific budgets
• Provide support with HR-related issues including onboarding new team members.
• Ensure the administrative interlink with the other  departments.

Can you make the difference?

The successful candidate will be an experienced professional who demonstrates the following experience and competencies:

• A minimum of 5 years of work experience, preferably as an assistant at senior management level
• Excellent written and oral communication skills
• Proficiency in IT, web management and social media skills
• Excellent level of English, written and spoken. Knowledge of other languages is an asset.
• Full proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
• Excellent time management and organisational skills with the ability to prioritise work accordingly
• Excellent interpersonal skills and customer orientation
• Understanding of underlying issues and proactively developing and evaluating solutions

Are you looking for a challenging job within one of the largest food groups in Belgium (pork meat)? Have you always been interested in pork processing and want the opportunity to learn how to debone a pig?                        

 Follow our intensive training program and quickly develop the necessary skills. As a reward for your eagerness to learn, you will receive a permanent contract.                                                   
Wij bieden
Our offer:

• Permanent contract after 25 days of training!
• Competitive salary 
• A whole bunch of benefits! Think of daily fresh meals in our company restaurant, 25% discount on personal meat orders, fun family activities, Christmas gifts, ... In short, too many to mention! 
• Job security and growth opportunities! Wij vragen
We are looking for ambitious and eager-to-learn individuals who can start early (start at 4.55 AM) and are flexible in their schedules depending on the season. 

You should be comfortable working in a cold environment and have an affinity for the food industry (pork meat), along with the associated quality and hygiene standards. 

You must be physically capable of standing and working all day and place importance on workplace safety. 

Language is not a barrier; everyone has equal opportunities, whether you speak English, French, or Dutch.
Het bedrijf
Westvlees guarantees sustainable production of pork. Their mission is to provide a healthy and tasty solution for every consumer at every meal occasion. As an employer, they place great importance on innovation, service, and quality, while centering family values in the company, which are essential to its operations.
